blocks.text: Release 2026.09.28.3 is being deployed in controlled batches. The notification is coalesced by environment, so later status updates can replace this card without creating a stack of stale notices.

blocks.title: Guardrails still active
items: Error-rate alert threshold is 0.5% over five minutes.
Payments traffic remains pinned to the previous revision.
Automatic rollback pauses the next batch if either regional probe fails.

blocks.title: Next milestones
items: Complete canary validation for the final 13 nodes.
Shift 25% of payments traffic after the stability window.
Mark the change complete and retain the rollback snapshot for 24 hours.
